info.title: gff-hab API
info.description: Generated from the Go types in package api. Do not edit. See docs/specs/hab-logic-api.md.

methods.name: hab.hello
methods.summary: First request on a control connection: agree a revision (spec 3.2).

params.name: label
params.description: Human label, such as phone or desk.

params.name: min_revision
params.description: Oldest API revision the client accepts.

params.name: peer
params.description: Set by a hab that dials another hab (client.kind hab): who is calling (mesh.md 3.2).

params.name: reconnect_token
params.description: Token from an earlier welcome (spec 3.7).

params.name: revision
params.description: Newest API revision the client speaks.

methods.name: hab.ping
methods.summary: Client liveness; send every 15 s when idle (spec 3.5).

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.summary: The schema of this API. Its result is the schema document and carries no seq.

methods.name: structure.get
methods.summary: Read the whole structure of the host.

methods.name: events.subscribe
methods.summary: Snapshot the objects in scope and start events (spec 3.5).

methods.name: pane.input
methods.summary: Write bytes to a pane's program as one write (spec 3.8).

params.name: data
params.description: Bytes to write. Give data or text.

params.name: text
params.description: UTF-8 text to write. Give data or text.

methods.name: data.ticket
methods.summary: A single-use ticket, valid 30 s, to open a data connection (spec 5.2).

params.name: observe
params.description: Observer stream: never takes ownership (spec 6.4).

methods.name: pane.take
methods.summary: Become the pane's size owner now (spec 6.3).

methods.name: pane.request
methods.summary: Become the size owner only if the pane has none (spec 6.3).

methods.name: pane.disown
methods.summary: Give up size ownership; the pane keeps its size (spec 6.3).

methods.name: pane.set_desired_size
methods.summary: Store this client's wanted size (spec 6.3).

methods.name: pane.redraw
methods.summary: Send a fresh snapshot, or nudge the program to redraw (spec 6.7).

params.name: mode
params.description: Default snapshot.

methods.name: devices.pair
methods.summary: Make a one-time pairing offer for a new device (transport.md 6.1). Needs the devices capability.

params.name: label
params.description: Label for the device that will pair.

methods.name: devices.list
methods.summary: List the devices in the hab's trust store (transport.md 5). Needs the devices capability.

methods.name: devices.revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a device and close its connections (transport.md 6.6). Needs the devices capability.

params.name: id
params.description: Device id to revoke.

methods.name: session.create
methods.summary: Start a program in a new pane and file it as a session (spec 3.9).

params.name: argv
params.description: Program and arguments. Default: the hab's $SHELL, else /bin/sh.

params.name: cols
params.description: Initial width. Default 80.

params.name: cwd
params.description: Absolute working directory. Default: project_dir, else the most recently used folder of the project, else the hab's home directory.

params.name: env
params.description: KEY=value entries added to the hab's own environment; an entry replaces the hab's value for its key.

params.name: harness
params.description: Detection manifest id of a harness to start, such as claude. Needs that harness's adapter.

params.name: idempotency_key
params.description: A key the client makes for this create, at most 128 bytes. A repeat with the same key gets the first create's ids and starts nothing.

params.name: name
params.description: Session name, unique on the host. Default: the program's base name, with -2, -3 and so on when taken.

params.name: project
params.description: Project id to file the session in. Give project or project_dir, or neither for an unfiled session.

params.name: project_dir
params.description: Absolute path inside a git repository. The hab finds the project by the repository's remote, else its root commit, and creates the project when it is new.

params.name: rows
params.description: Initial height. Default 24.

methods.name: session.resume
methods.summary: Start an exited session's harness again in a new pane, with its resume id.

methods.name: pane.close
methods.summary: Release a pane: a running program gets a hang-up first (spec 3.9).

methods.name: session.rename
methods.summary: Give a session a new name. A name another session holds is refused with conflict.

params.name: name
params.description: The new name; unique among the host's sessions, exited ones included.

methods.name: session.close
methods.summary: Remove a session record. A live pane keeps running, unfiled; pane.close ends a program.

methods.name: session.focus
methods.summary: Report whether the session is in focus on this client: marks done seen, and holds pushes while watched.

params.name: active
params.description: True while the session is on screen in an active window.

methods.name: session.interrupt
methods.summary: Stop the agent's current turn through its adapter.

methods.name: session.send
methods.summary: Send a message to the session's agent through its adapter, under the input rules.

params.name: attachments
params.description: Attachment ids from attachment.put.

params.name: idempotency_key
params.description: A key the client makes for this message, at most 128 bytes. A repeat with the same key gets the first send's answer and writes nothing.

methods.name: approval.answer
methods.summary: Answer a pending request by id. A closed or expired id is refused with conflict.

params.name: choice
params.description: allow or deny a permission; answer a question with text.

params.name: request
params.description: The request id from the pane's agent state.

params.name: text
params.description: With choice answer: the chosen option or free text.

methods.name: chat.page
methods.summary: Read a page of the session's chat messages from the transcript reader. Needs the transcripts capability.

params.name: after
params.description: A cursor from an earlier page: return the messages added or changed since it, oldest first. Not with before.

params.name: before
params.description: Message id: return the messages before it. Absent means the tail.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most messages to return. Default 50, at most 200.

methods.name: attachment.put
methods.summary: Start an upload of a file for a session; the bytes follow on their own channel.

params.name: name
params.description: File name as the owner sees it.

params.name: sha256
params.description: Hex SHA-256 of the bytes.

params.name: size
params.description: Bytes.

params.name: type
params.description: Media type, such as image/png.

methods.name: attachment.get
methods.summary: Fetch an attachment or its thumbnail.

params.name: thumbnail
params.description: Return a small preview image instead of the file.

methods.name: push.register
methods.summary: Store an APNs device token for this device. Needs the push capability.

params.name: device_id
params.description: The device's key fingerprint (transport.md 5).

params.name: hide_commands
params.description: True: banners say "Approval needed" with no command, and offer no Approve (app.md 16.1).

params.name: kinds
params.description: The kinds of push this device wants.

params.name: token
params.description: APNs device token, hex.

methods.name: push.register_activity
methods.summary: Store a Live Activity token for the session this device tracks. Needs the push capability.

params.name: token
params.description: Live Activity push token, hex.

methods.name: push.unregister
methods.summary: Drop a push token. Needs the push capability.

methods.name: notice.raise
methods.summary: Raise a Flightdeck notification: a notice.raised event to subscribers, and a push where push is set up.

params.name: body
params.description: Up to 16 words and 100 characters; shortened the same way.

params.name: level
params.description: Default active.

params.name: session
params.description: The session the notice is about: its project names the banner, and a client watching it gets no push.

params.name: title
params.description: Up to 8 words and 50 characters; a longer title is shortened with an ellipsis.

methods.name: usage.list
methods.summary: The latest usage reading of each harness account on this hab.

methods.name: hab.stats
methods.summary: CPU, memory, disk, battery and uptime of the host. Needs the host-stats capability.

methods.name: command.list
methods.summary: Read a page of a pane's shell commands, found by OSC 133 marks (spec 2.5). Needs the commands capability.

params.name: before
params.description: Command id: return the commands before it. Absent means the newest.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most commands to return. Default 100, at most 1000.

methods.name: command.output
methods.summary: Read a run of one command's output from the holder's ring (spec 2.5). Needs the commands capability.

params.name: command
params.description: Command id.

params.name: from
params.description: Offset to read from. Absent means the output's start.

params.name: limit
params.description: Most bytes to return. Default and most 1 MiB.

methods.name: peers.list
methods.summary: This hab's peers with their link state, and habs linked to it that it does not list (mesh.md 3, 4.3). Needs the mesh capability.

methods.name: peers.accept
methods.summary: Pin the device id a peer presented in place of the pinned one (transport.md 6.3). Needs the mesh capability.

params.name: label
params.description: The peer whose new device id to accept.

methods.name: catalog.get
methods.summary: This hab's own catalog, whole, when its generation differs from since (mesh.md 5.2). Needs the catalog capability.

params.name: since
params.description: The generation the caller holds; 0 for none.

methods.name: catalog.put
methods.summary: A peer link hands over its own hab's catalog (mesh.md 4.2). Needs the catalog capability.

params.name: catalog
params.description: The caller's own catalog. Its device_id must be the peer link's.

methods.name: catalog.list
methods.summary: The merged view: this hab's catalog and its direct peers' copies, with projects matched across hosts (mesh.md 5.2). Needs the catalog capability.

methods.name: hab.permissions
methods.summary: Check the permission grants of the holders, from a probe pane, and of gff-hab (macos-identity.md 7.2). Needs the permissions capability.

params.name: grants
params.description: Check only these grants (macos-identity.md 7.1 names, plus domain, background-item, signature, files-and-folders and pasteboard). Absent checks every grant.

params.name: request
params.description: Ask macOS for this one grant before the check, where an API can: accessibility, screen-recording, local-network, files-and-folders or pasteboard. It may show a dialog; only the setup walk sends it.

methods.name: detect.explain
methods.summary: Say why a pane shows its agent state: the source that won, the process match and each screen rule's region and result (harness-adapters.md, Detection). Needs the detect-explain capability.

params.name: pane
params.description: Pane id. Give pane or session.

params.name: session
params.description: Session id or name; the session's live pane is explained.

x-notifications.name: event
x-notifications.summary: One event; see the event types (spec 3.5).

x-notifications.name: heartbeat
x-notifications.summary: Sent every 15 s when no other event was sent.

x-notifications.name: closing
x-notifications.summary: Sent once before the server closes the connection.

x-events.summary: A project was created or changed.
A session was created or changed, including its exit.
A client sent input; at most once per second per client (spec 7.1).
A pane's agent state changed (harness-adapters.md, State event model). The id is the pane id.
A pane rang the bell; at most once per second per pane. Ephemeral.
A pane printed; at most once per second per pane, for activity marks. Ephemeral.
A chat message was appended or changed; the id is the message id. Ephemeral.
The agent's turn ended; the id is the session id. Ephemeral.
An account's usage reading changed; the id is the account key. Ephemeral.
A pane's command started or ended; the id is the pane id (spec 2.5). Ephemeral.
A peer's link state changed; the id is the peer's label (mesh.md 4.3). Host scope only. Ephemeral.
A catalog this hab holds changed: its own or a peer's copy; the id is the device id (mesh.md 5.2). Host scope only. Ephemeral.
A notice was raised (notice.raise); the id is the notice id. Ephemeral.

x-frames.name: snapshot
x-frames.layout: 8-byte big-endian offset it covers, 1-byte encoding name length, encoding name, screen bytes

x-frames.name: bytes
x-frames.layout: 8-byte big-endian offset of the first byte, then program output

at.description: RFC 3339 time gff-hab accepted the change.

harness.description: claude, codex, opencode, or another detection manifest id.

hooks.description: missing: the harness finished a turn and none of its hooks reached gff-hab. Its hook config is not installed, or (Codex) not trusted. Absent once a hook arrives.

last.description: With state exited: the last done or error before the harness ended.

pane.description: Pane id; also the event's id.

request.description: Only with state blocked and kind permission.

revision.description: Per pane, raised on every accepted change. Restarts with the epoch.

session.description: The harness's native session id, once known.

turn.description: The harness's turn or prompt id, where it gives one.

warning.description: Set while the harness version is outside the adapter's tested range.

choice.description: allow or deny a permission; answer a question with text.

request.description: The request id from the pane's agent state.

text.description: With choice answer: the chosen option or free text.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

thumbnail.description: Return a small preview image instead of the file.

name.description: File name as the owner sees it.

path.description: Where the hab stored the file, inside the project's attachment folder.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

actions.description: Quick actions the user declared for this host.

always_on.description: The user marked this host always on (mesh.md 8).

at.description: RFC 3339 time of the last change, by the publishing hab's clock.

capabilities.description: Detected and declared capability words, sorted.

generation.description: Raised on every change of this catalog; kept across restarts.

harnesses.description: Coding-agent harnesses found on PATH, with their versions.

peers.description: The device ids in this hab's peer list.

projects.description: Git projects on this host, one per identity.

services.description: Services the user declared for this host.

toolchains.description: Tools found on PATH, with their versions.

watches.description: The peers marked always on that this hab watches: each is in its peer list and its copy carries the mark (mesh.md 8).

project.description: The project's name. Absent for an unfiled session.

session.description: The session's name on its host.

label.description: This hab's label for the peer. Absent for this hab and for a hab not in the peer list.

seen_at.description: RFC 3339 time this hab last confirmed the copy with the peer.

stale.description: The peer is offline; the copy is its last.

dirty.description: Changes or untracked files. Absent when not read yet.

head.description: Full commit id of HEAD. Absent before the first commit.

since.description: The generation the caller holds; 0 for none.

catalog.description: The whole catalog. Absent when generation equals since.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

hosts.description: This hab first, then its peers' copies in peer list order.

projects.description: Projects matched by identity across hosts.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

remote.description: The normalized git remote that identifies the project.

root_commit.description: The root commit, when the project has no remote.

summary.description: The first line of AGENTS.md, else README, in its first folder.

locations.description: One per host, in host order.

catalog.description: The caller's own catalog. Its device_id must be the peer link's.

health.description: A health URL, as the user wrote it.

arch.description: Go GOARCH word, such as amd64 or arm64.

os.description: linux, darwin, or another Go GOOS word.

version.description: The first version-like word of its version output. Absent when none was found.

attachments.description: Attachment ids shown on the message.

event.description: With kind event: what the line marks. unknown marks a transcript record the reader does not know; text names it. reset, sent only as an event, says the transcript was replaced: take the tail again.

id.description: Stable within the session; an update carries the same id.

parent.description: The message id of the subagent call this message belongs to.

plan.description: With kind plan: the steps in order.

sender.description: Another agent that sent this message (channels).

text.description: Markdown for user and agent text; a line for an event.

cursor.description: Opaque. Pass it as after to read only what was added or changed since this page.

more.description: True when older messages exist. With after: true when more changes wait after cursor.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

after.description: A cursor from an earlier page: return the messages added or changed since it, oldest first. Not with before.

before.description: Message id: return the messages before it. Absent means the tail.

limit.description: Most messages to return. Default 50, at most 200.

input.description: The tool input as the harness wrote it, when it is at most 64 KiB.

output.description: The first part of the tool output.

output_truncated.description: True when output holds only the first part of a longer output.

target.description: A short target: a file, a command.

cwd.description: Working directory the shell last reported with OSC 7 before the command started. Absent when it reported none. At most 1 KiB.

dropped.description: In a command.updated event only: how many changes of this pane, older than this one, the hab left out to bound its events. Read command.list to catch up.

end.description: Offset where the output ends: the command-end mark (D), or what closed the command. Absent while it runs.

ended_at.description: RFC 3339 time the command ended. Absent while it runs, or when unknown.

exit.description: Exit status from the D mark. Absent when the mark had none, or no D came.

id.description: Offset of the command's output-start mark (C). Unique in the pane, and the same after a hab restart.

input.description: Offset just after the command-start mark (B): the typed line starts here. Absent when the shell sent none.

output.description: Offset just after the C mark: the first byte of output.

prompt.description: Offset of the prompt-start mark (A) before it. Absent when the shell sent none.

started_at.description: RFC 3339 time the C mark arrived. Absent when the hab found the mark in replayed output.

text.description: The command line, when the shell sent it in the C mark (cmdline_url). At most 1 KiB.

text_truncated.description: True when text was cut: at 1 KiB, or by the mark's 4 KiB payload cap.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

before.description: Command id: return the commands before it. Absent means the newest.

limit.description: Most commands to return. Default 100, at most 1000.

command.description: The command as it stood when the bytes were read.

data.description: The output bytes in [start, end), marks excluded.

end.description: Offset after the last byte of data; pass it as from to read on.

gap.description: True when the ring no longer held bytes before start.

more.description: True when output goes on past end: the limit cut it, or the command still runs.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

start.description: Offset of the first byte of data.

from.description: Offset to read from. Absent means the output's start.

limit.description: Most bytes to return. Default and most 1 MiB.

bytes.description: Bytes the client applied: the screen bytes of snapshot frames and the program output of bytes frames, without their offsets and names.

offset.description: Holder offset after the last byte the client applied, to resume.

stream.description: Id of this stream, for logs.

applied.description: True when the PTY took this size.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

agent.description: The pane's agent state now; its source is the source that won. Absent when no source has reported for the pane.

manifest.description: The manifest whose screen rules ran. Absent when neither the foreground process nor the agent state names one.

open_request.description: The open permission request; only a hook or server closes it.

owner_stop.description: The owner's interrupt key shows idle; session.send waits until the harness itself reports.

screen.description: The screen rules over the pane's screen now. Absent with no manifest, or when the screen could not be read.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

turn_source.description: The strongest source that spoke this turn: a weaker one cannot change the state until the turn ends. Absent after a reset, when the next report of any source wins.

pane.description: Pane id. Give pane or session.

session.description: Session id or name; the session's live pane is explained.

chosen_by.description: process: the foreground process matched it; agent: the pane's agent state names its harness.

from.description: vendored: built into gff-hab; data: refreshed into the state directory.

args.description: argv, where readable. Outside Linux it is split on white space.

match.description: The manifest id its first matching name resolves to.

name.description: The executable name the system reports.

names.description: The names it offers, in the order they are tried.

error.description: Why the group or its processes could not be read.

match.description: The manifest id the process part found. Absent when no process matches.

pgid.description: The PTY's foreground process group; 0 when it has none.

processes.description: The group's processes in the order they are tried: the leader first, then the others by pid.

text.description: The region's text as the rule read it, cut to its last 2048 bytes. osc_title and osc_progress read empty: this build does not track them.

lines.description: The lines the rules read: the visible rows, trailing blank ones dropped.

rule.description: The winning rule: the matching rule of highest priority, the first in the file on a tie.

state.description: What the screen says: idle, working, blocked or unknown (no rule matched).

id.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the device's public key, in the standard SSH form.

paired_by.description: Device id of the client that confirmed the pairing.

devices.description: Paired and revoked devices; revoked ones stay as tombstones.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

label.description: Label for the device that will pair.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

id.description: Id of the object the event is about.

revision.description: The object's revision after the change. Absent on ephemeral events (spec 3.5, 3.9).

label.description: Human label, such as phone or desk.

min_revision.description: Oldest API revision the client accepts.

peer.description: Set by a hab that dials another hab (client.kind hab): who is calling (mesh.md 3.2).

revision.description: Newest API revision the client speaks.

id.description: The hab's host id, from config.

battery_pct.description: Absent on a host with no battery.

cpu_pct.description: CPU in use over the last few seconds, as a percentage of all cores. Absent where the host cannot measure it.

disk_used.description: Bytes, on the file system of the hab's state directory.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

data.description: Bytes to write. Give data or text.

text.description: UTF-8 text to write. Give data or text.

body.description: Up to 16 words and 100 characters; shortened the same way.

session.description: The session the notice is about: its project names the banner, and a client watching it gets no push.

title.description: Up to 8 words and 50 characters; a longer title is shortened with an ellipsis.

id.description: The notice id; also the notice.raised event's id.

pushed.description: Devices the push goes to. 0 when push is not set up or every device is held by presence.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

owner.description: Owner after the call. Absent means no owner.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

device_id.description: The hab's host-key fingerprint, to pin.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

owner.description: Client id of the size owner (spec 6.1).

count.description: Bells since the last pane.bell for this pane.

offset.description: The pane's holder offset after the output.

owner.description: New owner client id. Absent means no owner.

device_id.description: The pinned device id. Absent before the first link.

endpoint.description: The endpoint in use while online, else the one tried last.

host.description: The peer's host id from its last welcome or hello.

inbound.description: The peer has a link to this hab open.

label.description: This hab's name for the peer, from its peer list.

last_seen.description: RFC 3339 time the peer was last online. Absent if never.

offered_id.description: State refused: the different device id the endpoint presented.

reason.description: Why the peer is not online, in a few words.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

peers.description: The peer list, in file order. This hab's own entry is left out.

problems.description: Entries of the peer file that could not be used, and why.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

unlisted.description: Habs linked to this one that are not in its peer list.

label.description: The peer whose new device id to accept.

command.description: The exact command, for a shell tool.

context_line.description: The agent's last message before the request, one or two lines, when the transcript has one.

description.description: A longer description of the call, when the harness gives one.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 time after which the hab refuses a remote answer with conflict. Absent when no deadline applies.

files.description: The exact files, for a file tool.

id.description: The harness's id for the request, when it gives one. A permission answer must name it.

input.description: The tool input as the harness sent it, when it is at most 64 KiB.

input_truncated.description: True when the tool input was over 64 KiB and input is left out.

title.description: A short question: the harness's own description of the call, else one built from the tool.

detail.description: One line for the user: what was found, or what to do.

draining.description: The holder is draining: it takes no new panes, so no probe runs in it.

grant.description: The grant's name, such as full-disk-access or automation:<bundle-id>.

instance.description: The holder instance a holder row is about.

remembered.description: The state is the answer the setup walk's last request saw, kept because no check can read this grant without a dialog. The grant may have changed since; the walk asks again.

required.description: The check fails unless the state is granted.

reveal.description: A path to show in Finder, so the user can drag it into the Settings list.

settings.description: The System Settings URL that changes this grant.

os.description: The hab's operating system as Go names it: darwin or linux.

os_version.description: The operating system's version, such as 27.2.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

grants.description: Check only these grants (macos-identity.md 7.1 names, plus domain, background-item, signature, files-and-folders and pasteboard). Absent checks every grant.

request.description: Ask macOS for this one grant before the check, where an API can: accessibility, screen-recording, local-network, files-and-folders or pasteboard. It may show a dialog; only the setup walk sends it.

ahead.description: Commits on the branch that its upstream lacks. Absent with no upstream.

behind.description: Commits on the upstream that the branch lacks. Absent with no upstream.

branch.description: Current branch of the repository in the project's folder. Absent on a detached HEAD or outside a repository.

head.description: Full commit id of HEAD. Absent outside a repository.

remote.description: Git remote that identifies the project.

root_commit.description: Root commit, when the project has no remote.

hide_commands.description: True: banners say "Approval needed" with no command, and offer no Approve (app.md 16.1).

kinds.description: The kinds of push this device wants.

ids.description: Project or session ids, for kind projects or sessions.

context_pct.description: How full the context window is, in whole percent of the current model's window. Absent when unknown; never guessed.

model.description: The model in use, as the harness names it.

title.description: The agent session's title, from its adapter. Absent when the harness has none.

argv.description: Program and arguments. Default: the hab's $SHELL, else /bin/sh.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory. Default: project_dir, else the most recently used folder of the project, else the hab's home directory.

env.description: KEY=value entries added to the hab's own environment; an entry replaces the hab's value for its key.

harness.description: Detection manifest id of a harness to start, such as claude. Needs that harness's adapter.

idempotency_key.description: A key the client makes for this create, at most 128 bytes. A repeat with the same key gets the first create's ids and starts nothing.

name.description: Session name, unique on the host. Default: the program's base name, with -2, -3 and so on when taken.

project.description: Project id to file the session in. Give project or project_dir, or neither for an unfiled session.

project_dir.description: Absolute path inside a git repository. The hab finds the project by the repository's remote, else its root commit, and creates the project when it is new.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

active.description: True while the session is on screen in an active window.

name.description: The new name; unique among the host's sessions, exited ones included.

idempotency_key.description: A key the client makes for this message, at most 128 bytes. A repeat with the same key gets the first send's answer and writes nothing.

agents.description: The current agent state of each pane that has one (harness-adapters.md, State event model). Absent from a hab without the agent-state capability.

seq.description: Seq of the last event queued for this connection before the request ran.

ticket.description: Single use, bound to this client.

final_message.description: Id of the turn's last agent message.

key.description: Stable, not secret: the adapter's hash of an account id, else the host and harness.

tested.description: Newest tested version, as a prefix: 2.1 covers every 2.1.x.

device_id.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the hab's own SSH host key, in the standard SSH form. Clients pin it (transport.md 5). Optional, so a newer client accepts a welcome from an older revision 1 hab.

epoch.description: Random id of this gff-hab process.
